body:
Run ADLC P1 on .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md (canonical copy; docs/specs/native-plugin-installation.md is currently a byte-identical duplicate) and produce a corrected, executable spec plus the four implementation tickets it decomposes into. No product code changes in this ticket.

Work:
1. Run adlc parallax --file, adlc premortem, adlc spec-lint on the spec (--prompt-only; answer as the model) and record verdicts with --record-verdict / --record --ticket t-plugin-00-spec.
2. Run live probes against the installed agy (>= 1.2.16) on Linux to verify or refute the spec's empirical claims: PreToolUse matcher syntax ("*" vs regex ".*"), whether parent env vars (AGB_HOOK_DISABLE, AGB_WORKER_TICKET) reach hook processes, hook cwd and PLUGIN_ROOT/PLUGIN_DATA env exposure in hooks/commands/MCP, behavior when a hook returns ask in a headless/non-interactive session, and whether agy can run with a temporary HOME. Probe plugins must use names prefixed probe- and be uninstalled afterwards; never modify the installed antigravity-booster or adlc-antigravity plugins.
3. Fold findings into the canonical spec and add an appendix 'Errata & Linux verification' listing every correction with its evidence. Known errata to resolve: (a) section 4.5.1 active-shard protection checks status in_progress/open but section 4.3 defines active as status not in {completed, closed, archived}; (b) section 4.4 describes the companion @adlc/antigravity hook as hooks/pre-tool-use.sh resolving a booster-vendored adlc, but the installed 1.7.0 plugin uses 'node $HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/adlc-antigravity/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.cjs' with matcher '.*' and timeout 20; (c) matcher '*' validity.
4. Fold owner decisions recorded 2026-10-04: CI re-downloads @adlc/antigravity@1.7.0 from npm and asserts byte-identity with vendor/cache/adlc-antigravity-1.7.0.tgz; no in-session allow decision (auto-approve-tests hook removed); live-agy acceptance checks live in test/live/*.live.test.mjs gated by AGB_LIVE_AGY=1 and excluded from npm test; top-level sidecars/ is the single dashboard source and is added to package.json files; T4 deletes all of .agents/; npm remains a secondary channel with bin.agb -> dist/agb.mjs, @adlc/* moved to devDependencies, doctor warns (not errors) on an npm-global agb; CHANGELOG entries under Unreleased, release 1.0.0 after T4.
5. Replace docs/specs/native-plugin-installation.md with a short pointer to the canonical .adlc/specs copy.
6. Author T-PLUGIN-01-CORE via adlc ticket create --write and pass adlc coldstart --prompt-only on it; author T-PLUGIN-02/03/04 as reviewed drafts under .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.tickets/ (written just-in-time).

Acceptance criteria:
1. adlc spec-lint .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md exits 0 and is recorded (adlc gate-manifest show lists spec-lint for t-plugin-00-spec).
2. premortem and parallax verdicts are recorded in .adlc/manifest.jsonl for t-plugin-00-spec.
3. The spec contains an 'Errata & Linux verification' appendix whose every entry cites a probe transcript or file path.
4. grep -n "in_progress' || shard?.status === 'open'" .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md returns nothing.
5. docs/specs/native-plugin-installation.md is under 40 lines and links the canonical path.
6. Per owner decision (2026-10-04, just-in-time tickets): adlc ticket list shows T-PLUGIN-01-CORE, and .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.tickets/ holds reviewed drafts for T-PLUGIN-02/03/04 with forward edges T2->T3->T4; each is written to the store when its predecessor merges.
7. adlc rails-guard --base main --ticket t-plugin-00-spec exits 0 (lib/lock.mjs and lib/gates.mjs untouched).
8. npm test passes (no code changes expected).
title: Interrogate, correct, and decompose the native Antigravity plugin installation spec
